entries.text: 蓝莓学园！\n好厉害啊～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_first_01

entries.text: 这蓝莓学园，\n和学院完全不一样！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_00

entries.text: 我去参观了一下生态巨蛋，\n真不敢相信那是在海里的！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_01

entries.text: 而根据学园的方针，\n宝可梦对战似乎也很被重视。\r\n也就是说……想对战多少场都行！？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_02

entries.text: 太好了！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 要适可而止哦！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 嗯！等做完要做的事，\n我一定要跟这里的人逐个对战！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_03

entries.text: 对不起，你说得对！\n我还要跟[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你对战，\r\n所以得留下余力才行，对吧？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp01_03b

entries.text: 我去生态巨蛋逛了一下，\n发现那里有很多没见过的宝可梦！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_00

entries.text: 就跟在北上那时一样，\n观察不认识的宝可梦\r\n在大自然中生活，真的很有趣～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_01

entries.text: 和在教科书上看的感觉\n完全不一样！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_02

entries.text: 感觉很真实！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 感觉很新鲜！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 没错没错！就是那感觉！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_03

entries.text: 话说这让我想起来帕底亚的宝可梦\n一开始也让我觉得很新鲜！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_04

entries.text: 我呀，是在７岁时\n搬到帕底亚的。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_05

entries.text: 当时还没接触宝可梦对战，\n我都把那种感觉给忘了～[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_06

entries.text: 还真的是勿忘初心啊！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_07

entries.text: 嘿，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n你知道什么是蓝莓联盟吗？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_00

entries.text: 知道哦！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 你在说什么……？
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 你果然知道！\n为什么没有马上告诉我呀～！？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_01

entries.text: 你是瞒不了我的！\n我已经查得一清二楚了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_01b

entries.text: 而且大家还说\n蓝莓联盟的冠军是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_02

entries.text: 我的确是！
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_select_03

entries.text: 你在说什么……？
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_select_04

entries.text: 我就说嘛！你果然是冠军！\n这些事你要快点告诉我呀～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_03

entries.text: 你是瞒不过去的！\n要是你不承认，我还有证人哦～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_03b

entries.text: 虽然我很想马上就跟\n蓝莓联盟的冠军对战……[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_04

entries.text: 但劲敌在各种地方大显身手，\n这一点更～让我高兴～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_05

entries.text: 嗯～所以……\n以后也请你多多指教哦！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_sp03_06

entries.text: ……感觉说着说着就正经起来了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_01_00

entries.text: 话说我们虽然\n对战过很多次，\r\n但还没试过进行交换呢！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_01_01

entries.text: 要不就趁这个机会\n来进行宝可梦交换吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_01_02

entries.text: 太好了！真让人高兴！\n我就用肯泰罗来跟你换吧～！\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，你会选哪个孩子呢？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_01_03

entries.text: 是[VAR 0x0101(0001)]！真棒！\n我会把它培育强大，让它无人能敌！\r\n谢谢你和我交换！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_01_04

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_02_03

entries.text:
你只带了１只宝可梦，
进行交换会有点危险哦！\c
让同行的宝可梦有２只以上
再进行交换，我想会比较好！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_03_00

entries.text: 你有别的事要做吗？\n那等下次再来交换吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_03_01

entries.text: 之前我们没能交换宝可梦，\n现在快来交换吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_trade_04_00

entries.text: 如果你有时间，\n要来跟我进行宝可梦对战吗？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_talkto_00

entries.text: 你是正在调整同行的队伍吗？\n嗯……真可惜！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_cancel_00

entries.text: 太好了！那就来吧！\n让我们来一场大有收获的对战吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 这次是我输了！\n啊～太有趣了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 真希望长大后也能随时随～地\n跟[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你对战啊～[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 能圆梦也好，\n去追梦更好！说定了哦！\r\n作为约定的证明，收下这个吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 使用时就当是我在帮你吧！\n今后也……请你多多指教！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_reward_00

entries.text: 这次是我输了！\n谢谢你和我对战！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 下次我不会输的！\n要再和我对战哦！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: 太好了～！\n这次是我赢了！\r\n不过，你打得很漂亮哦！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
蓝莓学园在上课时
不怎么使用教室啊！\c
居然会在巨蛋中上课，
简直是文化冲击啊！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_randomtalk_00

entries.text: 虽然发生了不少事，\n但在北上乡真的过得很快乐！\r\n好想再和大家一起去旅行啊～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
听说蓝莓学园
也有四天王！\c
他们会用什么宝可梦呢！？
嗯～好在意啊！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_randomtalk_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]在不断成长蜕变哦！\n让交换的宝可梦相互对战，\r\n或许也会很有趣！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
我交换给你的肯泰罗
在之前的寻宝中帮了我不少忙哦！\c
如果[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你能好好培育它，
我会非常非常开心的！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_randomtalk_04
